report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency, but current gateway telemetry is largely healthy: error_rate 0.001, p95 71ms, zero dependency timeouts and pool waiters, INFO 200 logs. Only one ERROR span shows gateway calling inventory at 2001ms. That single span is insufficient to establish a bounded root cause, and healthy metrics contradict the alert premise. Handing off for downstream and dependency telemetry.
missing_evidence: Traces for order, inventory, payment, and postgresql services in the alert window to localize the 2001ms error span
Inventory service metrics (latency, error rate, redis timeouts) to test downstream-latency or redis-timeout causes
Gateway metrics over a longer window to confirm whether the 0.001 error rate and p95 71ms contradict the alert
Redis and postgresql dependency telemetry to rule out db-pool-exhaustion or redis-timeout
